brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full plus piece:0,1,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full and piece:1,1,0;half-n form base structure
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) drop into cells and are removable
drawer:0#1,1#cut on half-n base at 1,1,0 provides enclosed drawer storage

No handle part installed in current build. A handle requires a cover to mount on (addCover + addHandle). Previous upper-level covers/handles were removed to allow bin installation and no handle was re-added; check_build shows meshClash clear but handle absent.

finish.summary: Portable base with two compartment bins and one drawer built. Carry handle not present in final configuration after rework to fit removable bins.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
